name: P2-B graph_color overnight robustness launch
purpose: Launch the SPEC Overnight Batch v0 P2-B graph_color robustness jobs that do not depend on the P1-A CSP Gate-3 calibration. The launch uses the already-validated graph_color KV-cache backjump harness: C1 conflict-analysis, chronological, oracle, and random policies over v14/v16/v18/v20 with R in {2,4,8,16}, plus queued v20/v22 A-cache vs C-incontext oracle-search cost jobs. Jobs run detached with per-shard checkpoints, logs, GPU labels, and a launch manifest.
